internal: Internal error – details in the CloudWatch log.
too_many_rules: At most {{max}} rules in the weekly plan.
rule_show_missing: A slot in the weekly plan has no podcast.

no_active_device: No active Spotify device found. Open Spotify on a device.

spotify_unavailable: Spotify is not responding – please try again later.
